name: OpenClaw
description: OpenClaw is an open-source AI agent with shell access, file system access, and persistent memory. Connects via Telegram, voice agents, or web interfaces. Runs in VM with hypervisor isolation for security.

notes.text: A random root password is generated automatically and displayed after VM creation. Save it to access the VM via SSH.
OpenClaw has shell access and runs with sudo privileges within the VM. Hypervisor isolation provides security from the Proxmox host.
This creates a VM (not LXC container) for enhanced security isolation required by AI agents with shell access.
OpenClaw is installed on first boot. After VM boots, SSH in and run 'sudo -u openclaw openclaw onboard' to configure AI provider and start the service.
The gateway binds to 127.0.0.1 (loopback) and is NOT exposed to the network. Communication with Telegram is outgoing only.
Setup instructions are available at /home/openclaw/SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.txt inside the VM.
Hardened install uses openclaw-ansible (UFW, Fail2ban, Tailscale, Docker). Takes ~10-15 min on first boot. User is 'clawdbot'. Run: sudo su - clawdbot && clawdbot onboard --install-daemon
